items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I worked with Leon at the 500 Club quite a while.

ctx.x: We had, originally there were a place called Beverly Gardens, still called Beverly Gardens, the street in Metry. And there was a club out there, Leon Prima bought the club. And Louis had the band, we played with him quite a while. Then we moved, moved in town here where they, it was a Toyssey's restaurant and they remodeled it and made a nightclub of it. Called it Prima's and then later the Shim Sham and later the Moulin Rouge on Bourbon Street. We're Syros now, has it. We worked there quite a while. You worked…
A couple years. I was here. See, what years were those?
